prompt: Without dividing exactly, which is the **best estimate** for $5{,}812 \div 29$?
hint: An estimate uses rounded numbers that are easy to divide in your head. What round numbers are these two close to?

hints.text: An estimate uses rounded numbers that are easy to divide in your head. What round numbers are these two close to?
Round $5{,}812$ to $6{,}000$ and round $29$ to $30$. Then work out $6{,}000 \div 30$ mentally.
$6{,}000 \div 30 = 200$, so the best estimate is $200$, choice B.

explanation: Round each number to one that is easy to work with: $5{,}812$ is about $6{,}000$ and $29$ is about $30$.
Divide the two rounded numbers: $6{,}000 \div 30 = 200$, because $30 \times 200 = 6{,}000$.
The exact quotient will be close to $200$, so the best estimate is choice B.
